title: Sum of Krawtchouk values
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\\in\\{\\pm1\\}^n$. For each $j$, sum the monomials $\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$ over all $j$-element subsets $S\\subseteq\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and then sum these values over $j=0,\\ldots,n$. The result is $2^n\\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}(1+x_i)/2$.�
